paragraphs: A full-stack campus event platform. Students discover and register for events and get a QR code for attendance; organizers create and run events (QR check-in, announcements, feedback, certificates); admins approve organizers and events and manage the platform.
features: Visitors — browse the home page, search/filter approved events, and view event details without an account.

Students — sign up / log in; register for events (a QR code is emailed); dashboard with upcoming and past events, participation analytics, announcements, pending feedback; download certificates after attending and…

Organizers (approved by an admin) — create events (visible after admin approval); add details, schedule, FAQs, speakers, highlights and gallery images; add collaborators; scan attendee QR codes with the camera; see…

AI assistance — students get personal event recommendations (with the reasons shown), "You might also like" suggestions on every event page, plain-English search ("free workshops this week") and an assistant that…

Admins — overview of users, events, organizers and revenue; accept organizer/admin requests; approve or reject events; manage profile catalogs (badges, interests, notification types, social platforms, preferences).

whatItDoes.text: A full-stack campus event platform. Students discover and register for events and get a QR code for attendance; organizers create and run events (QR check-in, announcements, feedback, certificates); admins approve organizers and events and manage the platform.

requirements.text: Visitors — browse the home page, search/filter approved events, and view event details without an account.

Students — sign up / log in; register for events (a QR code is emailed); dashboard with upcoming and past events, participation analytics, announcements, pending feedback; download certificates after attending and giving feedback; edit profile, interests, preferences and social links; request their QR again.
